quickTasks.title: Build & Send Quote
quickTasks.note: Sales staff can build and share a proposal link; automated sending needs configured office messaging and consent.

quickTasks.title: Daily Crew & Truck Dispatch
quickTasks.note: Eligible driver, skill, availability, and acknowledged warnings are required.

quickTasks.title: On-Site Job Sheet & Signatures
quickTasks.note: Field crew must have an active linked crew profile and assignment to the job.

quickTasks.title: Storage Vault Intake
quickTasks.note: Dispatchers can also perform physical intake under the current role rules. Billing remains finance-only.

quickTasks.title: Monthly Storage Invoices
quickTasks.note: Generate invoices writes records, not customer charges; billing cycles are duplicate-protected.

fieldChecklist.en: Open /app/field and select the active move.
Save Pre-Move Walkthrough and damage photos.
fieldChecklist.ru: Сохраните осмотр до переезда и фотографии повреждений.

fieldChecklist.en: Tap Clock In at job arrival.
fieldChecklist.ru: По прибытии нажмите «Начать рабочее время» для задания.

fieldChecklist.en: Save Post-Move Walkthrough, tap Clock Out, and verify calculated hours and invoice.
fieldChecklist.ru: Сохраните осмотр после переезда, завершите рабочее время и проверьте рассчитанные часы и счет.

fieldChecklist.en: Capture the customer signature and launch checkout.
fieldChecklist.ru: Получите подпись клиента и откройте страницу оплаты.
